passages.document: NYAG press release "Attorney General James Announces Court Order Against ‘Crypto’ Currency Company Under Investigation For Fraud," published on ag.ny.gov, dated on-page April 25, 2019. Distinct from the already-frozen signed ex parte order PDF (2019.04.24_signed_order.pdf) -- this is the AG's own press statement summarizing and quoting "filings" made with the Manhattan Supreme Court (the Whitehurst affirmation / petition / memorandum of law referenced by the signed order, which could NOT independently be located as a standalone document -- see instrument_gap_affirmation_petition below).
passages.verbatim_passage: “Our investigation has determined that the operators of the ‘Bitfinex’ trading platform, who also control the ‘tether’ virtual currency, have engaged in a cover-up to hide the apparent loss of $850 million dollars of co-mingled client and corporate funds,” said Attorney General James.

instrument_gap_affirmation_petition_memo.conclusion: Per the task's own framing, this is a different angle from two prior attempts (which searched for Tether counsel's ~2019-04-30 percentage disclosure); this confirms the AG's OWN affirmation/petition/memorandum of law (the Whitehurst papers) is likewise not present anywhere in ag.ny.gov's Wayback-crawled footprint for this window. The dollar figures the affirmation would contain were, however, recovered secondhand -- quoted/paraphrased in the AG's own press release (see the 4 passages above), which IS an AG-authored document, just not the affirmation itself. A human with NYSCEF e-filing access to docket 450545/2019 remains the most direct remaining path to the affirmation text verbatim.
